approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical event promo for LANTERN NIGHT. Cinematic dark park after nightfall, many warm amber glowing paper lanterns hanging safely from tree branches, gentle breeze, soft golden bokeh, magical welcoming atmosphere. One continuous slow forward camera move, stable composition. No speech, no voiceover, no audio. Typography is the most important requirement: display crisp, large, stationary, highly legible centered event typography over a darkened central area, with generous safe margins. Exact text, spelled precisely, in three separate blocks: top 'LANTERN NIGHT'; center '14 NOVEMBER 2026'; below center 'WILLOW PARK, BRISTOL'. Make date and venue especially large and high contrast in warm white bold simple sans-serif, readable on a phone. Keep all three text blocks fully visible for the entire eight seconds, no changing letters, no extra text, no logos. Lanterns frame the text along the edges without obscuring it. Beautiful amber light against deep midnight blue and dark tree silhouettes.
